name: Biwei Huang
title: Assistant Professor
fitReason: Strong robot-learning and world-model match within a broader causal-learning program. Current research connects interaction-aware reinforcement learning with embodied representations; the homepage explicitly identifies VLA and world models as a recruiting area.

physicalEvidence.summary: The June 2026 IWR paper reports sim-trained policies executed on a real UR5e air-hockey robot. Its physical evaluation is 12 successes across 20 goals. Huang is a UCSD coauthor with an equal-advising role; the collaboration includes UT Austin. Equipment location and independent access through her lab remain unverified.

shortVisit.summary: The current homepage welcomes new students and postdocs from HDSI, CSE and related departments, and separately recruits a VLA/world-model postdoc. No external-master’s summer, internship or short-visit invitation was verified.

unknowns: Summer 2027 availability, eight-week scope, external-master’s mentoring, financial support, remote participation and robot access require individual confirmation.
Do not convert local degree-student or postdoc recruitment into an external visiting-master’s offer. Short-visit evidence remains zero.

IWR trains in simulation and executes on hardware using structured state inputs; it is not an end-to-end visual-language-action demonstration. The real-transfer table row is randomized simulation, separate from the real-robot row. Appendix captions saying 20/20 achieved goals should not override the actual 12/20 result.

The robot uses camera-based puck tracking and human-demonstrated reset policies. The paper establishes real learned execution, but not apparatus ownership at UCSD. Collaborative physical evidence is capped at 20.

Reuse the existing UCSD Visiting Graduate Student note: external master’s students may be considered for degree-related onsite research with host and graduate approvals; no minimum term is stated. Institutional eligibility is not a lab invitation, and international processing needs advance planning.
Public robot research does not confirm current equipment access, a summer 2027 offer or host availability.
